old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-zx7h","title":"Gateway TOFU store has no peer bound or admission backpressure","description":"Security review P2. TrustStore::verify_tofu inserts every new valid key-derived IID into an unbounded std HashMap. An untrusted discovery source can cheaply generate unlimited key/IID pairs and grow memory indefinitely; there is no MAX_PEERS, eviction policy safe for live pins, admission rate limit, or explicit full error. Bound the trust store, require deliberate admission/backpressure at capacity, never evict active pins on attacker input, and add capacity/flood tests.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:23.149837Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:23.149837Z"}
